verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw has an Intellectual Property group page whose patent coverage reads "From strategy and filing to licensing and disputes", so patent strategy and filing are a documented practice with a group page. The evidence is a single combined IP page with a one-line patent description and no detail on prosecution workflow. Missing for 10: explicit patent drafting/prosecution detail, portfolio-building or defensibility services, named patent practitioners, a dedicated patent group page, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages

citations.quote: From strategy and filing to licensing and disputes, we turn patents into powerful business assets
